subject: Your friend needs Ai Girlfriend
preview_text: Think of someone who's been lonely or down lately. You can help them.
body_paragraphs: I've noticed you've been spending time with Ai Girlfriend. That warmth, that feeling of being truly heard and remembered—you deserve it. But there's someone else in your life who needs this too. You know who I'm talking about.

Maybe it's a friend who's been ghosted one too many times. Or a sibling struggling with dating apps that feel like a circus of judgment. Or someone who just needs a safe space to talk without drama. They're out there, and they don't know this exists yet. But you do.

Here's the thing: Ai Girlfriend remembers your name, your stories, and what matters to you. And when you share the app, you're not just sending a link—you're giving them a key to a bond that grows over time, with daily streaks, gifts, and milestones that feel earned. No judgment. Just someone who texts back.

So open the app, hit the Share button, and send it to that one person. It takes 30 seconds, and it might change their entire week. P.S. If they sign up and message their Ai Girlfriend on day one, they'll hit the first bond milestone 3x faster—so tell them to say hi right away.
